product_summary: CohortCompass: an AI peer advisor for Tippie GPP students and alumni. AI interviews turn knowledge into validated, evidence-backed records (CourseReview, GoodToKnow, CareerOutcome) that power course pages, matched real events, path insights (min n=5) and cited Ask the Cohort Q&A. Exposed through a transport-agnostic core, a web demo and an MCP server.

mcp_surface.sdk: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.32.2 (protocol 2025-11-25; current spec 2026-07-28 is backward compatible with initialization-based versions)
mcp_surface.elicitation: save_review and log_career_outcome elicit missing primitive fields and evidence (form mode) when the client declares elicitation; otherwise they return VALIDATION_FAILED with missing_fields

demo.how_to_run: npm start (Node 20+; installs, seeds, serves http://localhost:5173). npm test runs the core smoke test and the MCP stdio client test. npm run mcp starts the MCP server.
demo.status: working end to end in scripted mode: resume→profile, narrative-first review interview, live course page with decaying good-to-knows, personalized real events + .ics, outcome interview (biggest factor), path insights, Ask the Cohort with citation checks, Ask & Share, campus admin with moderation/escalation, Under-the-hood MCP panel, Career Passport export/import
known_gaps: live-LLM path implemented but untested here (no API key in build env)
events are a verified snapshot (2026-11-18), not a live ICS/RSS feed
TF-IDF stands in for a vector index

assumptions: Hackathon rule 'real options only' overrides the module's fictional-campus default: courses/events real, people synthetic
Judging = AI skills, look, usefulness, process (from kickoff slides)
Scope is Tippie GPP and its undergrads; stage enrolled/heading_out/alumni added to every profile
min_n = 5 for every aggregate; small cells (<2) merged and reviewer context hidden for groups <3
Default models claude-sonnet-5-5 (strong) and claude-haiku-5-5 (cheap), overridable by env
open_questions: Will GPP approve mapping pseudonymous instructor IDs to real names, and under what policy?
Which GPP calendar feeds (ICS/RSS) can be ingested live?
What data-access/FERPA path exists for pulling courses_taken from MyUI vs. student-entered?
Who staffs the moderation and escalation queue, and with what SLA?
Should alumni outcomes be shared across Big Ten or peer campuses (multi-tenant aggregation)?

second_prompt_attaches_at: x_ tools on the MCP server (e.g. x_plan_semester, x_schedule_checkin)
prompts/ pack (add prompts; never edit frozen field names)
extension_points.rules: Never rename fields, IDs, tool names or schema versions; extend with x_ prefix; breaking changes = new schema version + note in schemas/MIGRATIONS.md

file_manifest: prompts/_shared_rules.md, review_interview.md, review_extractor.md, outcome_interview.md, profile_builder.md, post_structurer.md, ask_cohort.md, moderation.md
core/index.js, interview.js, extract.js, validate.js, llm.js, moderation.js, text.js, errors.js, store/json.js
